title: Query Client
description: Understand the QueryClient and its role in React Query.

data.text: **QueryClient** is the heart of React Query. It manages the cache, handles query execution, and provides methods to interact with queries.

items: **invalidateQueries**: Mark queries as stale and refetch

data.title: QueryClient
Query Keys
data.text: Query keys identify queries in the cache. Use arrays like ['users', userId] for hierarchical keys.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Provides methods to interact with queries
data.takeaway: QueryClient is the central cache manager.
